anna (Marketing): Heads-up — planning to publish the Orbit launch post tomorrow 10am PT. Need final changelog link, docs canonical URL, and a 1-line benchmark headline for the slide deck. Can eng confirm deploy timeline? @diego

diego (Eng Release): Canary at 07:30 PT, full rollout by 09:00 PT. Changelog PR will be merged by 07:00 PT: https://github.com/redwood-inference/orbit/pull/499

leah (Docs): Docs staging live at https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/orbit/1.4 by 06:50 PT. Ill push canonical /docs/orbit/1.4 at 08:00 PT once redirects are set.

mike (Product): Marketing needs a short customer-impact blurb (1-2 lines) + two bullets for the meta summary.

sam (Design): Can we get a simple PNG of the performance chart (1200x600) by 08:30 so slides look polished?

diego (Eng Release): Draft changelog bullets: - ~20% p95 decode improvement on A100 via KV-cache tweaks. - New fallback routing to avoid regional capacity spikes. Ill attach the perf PNG to the PR by 08:15.

ci-bot: CI passed on main and docs redirect job succeeded.

anna (Marketing): Great — Ill draft the post using staging docs and replace the URL when canonical is live. If you post the final PR link here by 07:00 PT well cut copy and schedule. Thanks everyone!
